about: Behaviour changes from the release notes, one entry per probed behaviour candidate (data/candidates/release_notes.json), not only the chosen concepts. old_gold and new_gold are the inventory symbols a concept on the change uses on each side; they may coincide. Entries count only when the probe found a direction (rules.behaviour_rules). These rules link gold pairs in validation step 7 and the doc-conflict test; they are never signals (user decision 2026-10-18).

rules.quote: Many users will now get "datetime64[us]" dtype data in cases when they used to get "datetime64[ns]" ... converting to integers, which will give integers 1000x smaller.
Now, the result name will be 'count' (or 'proportion' if normalize=True was passed), and the index will be named after the original object (GH 49497).
date_range() and timedelta_range() no longer default to unit="ns"
pandas now uses zoneinfo from the standard library (or datetime.timezone for fixed offsets) as the default timezone representation
In DataFrame.stack(), the default value of future_stack is now True
Removed specifying include_groups=True in DataFrameGroupBy.apply() and Resampler.apply()
Methods that can operate in-place ... now return the modified DataFrame or Series (self) instead of None when inplace=True.
Now it performs inference on the appropriate resolution
The str dtype can only hold strings (or missing values), in contrast to object dtype.
Because every single indexing step now behaves as a copy, this also means that "chained assignment" ... will stop working.
Changed default of numeric_only to False in all DataFrame methods with that argument
